Beyond the portfolio

I start with the audience: who they are, what they need to hear, and which format will make them listen.

Whether it is a press release, a script or a voice-over for a short film, I look for the story that carries the message. My work spans institutional communication at a ministry and a correctional facility, and production at a national broadcaster, so I am used to balancing creativity with a clear communication goal.
